question: To grant autonomy to firms, some public sector units were given special status. Which of the following was NOT one of the statuses?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Devratnas**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Devratnas**:

 
 
• **This is not an actual status** granted to PSUs.
 
• It is a fictional term.
 
• The** statuses given to PSUs are Maharatna, Navratna, and Miniratna. **
